thought.text: The backend is serving API docs and swagger. Let me verify seeded content is queryable and confirm the whole lifecycle commands work.

reasoning_content:
The API responds with openapi docs and swagger-ui. Health endpoint is on port 8081 internally not exposed. API works. Let me also verify seeded data through an API endpoint (e.g. /api/...). Let me check what endpoints exist. Let me query the openapi spec for a public endpoint and fetch some seeded content.

Also let me confirm the seeding marker exists and that sample data got seeded.

action.command:
cd /workspace; ls -la .urbo/urbo/; echo "--- seeded marker ---"; cat .urbo/urbo/seeded 2>/dev/null; find .urbo -name '*seed*'; echo "--- try some api endpoints ---"
for p in /api/legal /api/pages /api/feature-configurations /api/news /api/events /api/tenants /api/v1/tenants; do
 code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --resolve "api.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://api.urbo.localhost$p")
 echo "$p -> $code"
done
